objective: One sentence: the separable output the recipient must produce. Replace every value in this example; the packet is fillable content for a task description or initial plan, not an API payload.

source.note: Pin the exact task identity and document revision or commit SHA the recipient should work from, never an unqualified latest link.

in: The exact files, questions, or records in scope
The one output this packet asks for
out: Anything the recipient must not touch, decide, or re-investigate

constraints: Read-only, or the exact writes allowed and where they may land
Every applicable STOP: actions that must not be attempted, and what to do instead
No credentials, environment values, or copied thread history belong in a packet

inputs.note: Only reference inputs the recipient can actually read; inline the few safe facts that have no readable home

acceptance: Each criterion is checkable by the owner from the reported evidence
State the command, record, or inspection that proves each criterion

limits.note: Budgets exclude full artifacts and inherited harness or system context. If the packet does not fit, narrow or split the scope; never silently truncate evidence or constraints.

result_location: Transient helpers return the work-result summary and evidence to the owner for persistence on the owner's task. Assigned native children persist results on their own tasks. Reference full evidence by document or work-product ID and revision or SHA.
continuation: The owner verifies a transient helper's returned result directly, or resumes durable child work from native completion or dependency events. No polling, no wake-only comments, and no redispatch of an unchanged objective and revision to get a preferred answer.
